components_factors_FactorEditor.004: Save directly without a proposal. Changes create a new version; historical evidence is never overwritten or inherited.
components_factors_FactorEditor.005: Parameters must be a JSON object of finite numbers.
components_factors_FactorEditor.014: OHLCV, arithmetic, sma / ema / std / zscore / delay / delta / ts_min / ts_max / abs / log. Trailing windows only; no arbitrary Python.
components_factors_FactorEditor.017: Why might this factor contain independent information?
components_factors_FactorEditor.020: An empty applicability list means unrestricted, not validated in all markets.

components_factors_FactorEvidence.007: Single-instrument time-series diagnostics, not portfolio performance. Overlapping bucket returns cannot be compounded. Calculated does not mean validated.
components_factors_FactorEvidence.018: Walk-forward, parameter sensitivity, strategy ablation, capacity and cross-market validation. This test period is now inspected and cannot remain a locked holdout after tuning.
components_factors_FactorEvidence.019: Funding, liquidation and mark-price effects are excluded. Adjusted means are not net perpetual returns.
components_factors_FactorEvidence.021: This experiment did not complete. The record is retained; repair the cause before retrying.
